product_summary: D2C Ayurvedic / nutraceutical brand (founded Dec 2021, New Delhi — North Ex Mall, Rohini Sector-9; founders Neha Sodhi and Manika Bahl). Real catalogue per vedarma.com/collections/all and vedarma.com/pages/about-us: (1) oral herbal tablets/capsules/syrups — Diabassist Tablets (Gurmar, Jamun beej, Karela), Fat Manage Capsules (Triphala, Guggulu, Vidanga), Gascrush Tablets, Gas Crush Herbal Syrup 200 ml, Colkuf Care Chewable Tablets (cough/sore throat), Shaktita Capsules, Piles Moksha, liver/lung/sleep/immunity/stress ranges; (2) hair oils — Hair Ropan 100 ml (rosemary, neem, castor, bhringaraj, amla), Tea Tree Oil 10 ml; (3) skin/face — De-Tan Powder 50 g, face care range; (4) body/massage oils — Pain Sutra Oil 100 ml, Pain Sutra Roll On, Veda Bosom Breast Massage Oil 50 ml; (5) personal care — Herbal Intim Foam Wash 100 ml; (6) food supplement — Moringa Powder 100 g; (7) combo packs. Sold via own site, Guardian Pharmacy stores across India, and airport/mall outlets (Dwarka, IGI Airport).
